cohortDefinition: For the current session's Core TYPE A/B/C Top20, sum rank points across the current and prior four US sessions: rank 1 earns 20 points through rank 20 earning 1; absence earns 0. Compare composite ranks 1-5 with 16-20.
returnDefinition: Close-to-close return from cohort date to the 5th, 10th, or 20th subsequent US market session; no look-ahead in cohort selection.
evidenceRule: Fewer than 10 mature cohorts is insufficient history; clear difference requires at least 20 mature cohorts, an absolute average spread of at least 2 percentage points, and a cohort-bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero.
overallConclusion: 已有完整近5日综合排名批次，但5/10/20日收益尚未成熟。

horizons.conclusion: 历史不足，暂无明显差异
